shairport._comment: AirPlay player. audiocontrol reads and controls shairport-sync over MPRIS; set "metadata_source": "udp" to read the UDP metadata socket on "port" instead.
shairport._coverart_comment: Directory shairport-sync writes cover art to. Only files from this directory are served as cover art.
shairport._session_ports_comment: Workaround: shairport-sync reports Stopped 10-30 s into a pause. While a sender has an open connection on one of these ports (AirPlay 2, AirPlay 1), audiocontrol keeps the song and shows it as paused. [] turns this off.
